title: Common definitions
description: Shared primitive types reused across the network schema.

Id.description: Opaque identifier. The schema never assumes a format (UUID, Firebase uid, ...).

GameName.description: A game-defined name, namespaced by the game: `<game>.<name>`, e.g. `temnorid-arena.round-ended`. The `session` namespace is reserved for this schema.

Data.description: Game-defined content. The schema does not look inside it; the game documents its own shapes.
